meta.what: Clan power over 50 simulated playthroughs (QA, docs/qa/clan-power-50.md)
meta.chapters: index 0..7 = chapters 1..8. power_start: after the chapter's turn (and the offers taken on arrival); power_end: just before the next chapter's turn (the end of the run for 8). Chapter 1: the state when the run starts.
meta.delta: per chapter, power moved by source: holding (+1 a place held at the turn), neglect (-5, a main clan not helped), gift (a clan's gift taken), quest (a quest handed in for the clan), story (a story choice or event's own power), turn_other (the rest of the turn), fall (a clan left with no place: power to 0), nemesis_broken. The sum of a chapter's delta is power_end - the previous power_end (checked on every row).
